'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]]
***[[Twelve-Day War]] ([[List of airstrikes during the Iran–Israel War|list of airstrikes]])
****The [[Israeli Air Force]] says it has targeted [[Mashhad Shahid Hasheminejad International Airport]] in [[eastern Iran]], destroying a [[Aerial refueling|refueling plane]] used by the [[Islamic Republic of Iran Air Force]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c2kqkd03xn5t (BBC News)]
****An Iranian [[ballistic missile]] strike on a residential building kills nine people, including three children, and injures over 200 others in [[Bat Yam]], [[Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/6-dead-including-2-children-in-iranian-missile-strike-on-bat-yam-apartment-building/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
****According to [[United States government|American officials]], [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] vetoed a plan by Israel to [[assassination|assassinate]] the [[supreme leader of Iran]], [[Ayatollah]] [[Ali Khamenei]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/trump-vetoed-an-israeli-plan-kill-irans-supreme-leader-us-officials-say-2025-06-15/ (Reuters)]
****The [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] reports that a [[Syria]]n civilian woman was killed after a [[drone warfare|drone strikes]] her home in rural [[Tartus Governorate]], Syria, which the group says was likely an Iranian drone. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/rights-group-says-woman-killed-in-western-syria-likely-by-iranian-drone/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
****The [[Israel Defense Forces]] confirms that they recovered the body of Israeli hostage Aviv Atzili, who was abducted by the [[Palestinian Islamic Jihad]] during the [[October 7 attacks]], in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] last Wednesday. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-06-15/ty-article/.premium/body-of-israeli-hostage-aviv-atzili-recovered-from-gaza-last-week-idf-confirms/00000197-631b-db73-aff7-7b5f32cc0000 (''Haaretz'')]
***[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[Israel]]i gunfire and airstrikes kill at least 41 [[Palestinians]] across [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/middle-east/2025/0615/1518606-israel-gaza-strikes/ (RTÉ News)]
***[[Rafah aid distribution killings]]
****At least eight people are killed and dozens of others are injured in a shooting near an [[humanitarian aid|aid distribution]] site near [[Rafah]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. Witnesses attribute the shooting to Israeli forces. [https://www.npr.org/2025/06/15/nx-s1-5434274/at-least-8-dead-in-shooting-near-israeli-and-us-supported-aid-sites-in-gaza (NPR)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia]] returns the bodies of 1,200 [[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian soldiers]] who were [[killed in action]] as part of a [[prisoner exchange]] agreement with [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-has-handed-over-another-1200-bodies-ukrainian-soldiers-russian-state-news-2025-06-15/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Callao earthquake]]
**A {{M|w|6.1}} [[earthquake]] hits [[Lima]], [[Peru]], killing one person and injuring at least five others. [https://efe.com/mundo/2025-06-15/peru-terremoto-lima-callao/ (Agencia EFE)]
*Twenty-five people are killed in lightning, rain-related incidents across [[India]] in the past 24 hours. [https://www.indiatoday.in/india/story/lightning-incessant-rains-25-people-dead-across-four-states-in-north-india-in-last-24-hours-2741088-2025-06-15 (India Today)]
*Seven people are killed, including an infant, when a [[Bell 407]] aircraft crashes in a forested area in bad weather while en route to the [[Kedarnath Temple]] in [[Kedarnath]], [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]]. [https://www.freepressjournal.in/india/uttarakhand-helicopter-crash-7-killed-including-infant-as-chopper-crashes-near-kedarnath-route-terrifying-visuals-surface (''The Free Press Journal'')]
*At least six people are killed, 25 are swept away, and 32 others are injured, including six critically, when a bridge over a river collapses at a popular tourist destination in Kundamala, [[Pune]], [[Maharashtra]], India. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/06/15/six-killed-25-swept-away-after-bridge-collapse-in-india-s-pune (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/2-killed-and-32-injured-after-a-bridge-collapses-at-a-tourist-destination-in-western-india/ (CTV News)]
*Three [[Hiking|hikers]] are killed by a [[lightning strike]] on [[Tschaggunser Mittagspitze|Mittagsspitze mountain]] in the [[Central Eastern Alps]], [[Austria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/three-hikers-killed-by-lightning-strike-austrian-alps-2025-06-16/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Gaza war protests]]
**Between 100,000 and 150,000 protesters march in [[The Hague]], [[Netherlands]], demanding that the [[Dutch government]] pressure Israel to halt its military campaign in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://apnews.com/article/netherlands-gaza-protest-hague-israel-4976ec568e1b61ad80fd5ab53df5871e (AP)]
*The [[51st G7 summit]] begins in [[Kananaskis Improvement District|Kananaskis]], [[Alberta]], [[Canada]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/americas/20250616-g7-leaders-canada-mideast-tariffs (France24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The [[MI6]] appoints [[Blaise Metreweli]] to lead as [[Chief of the Secret Intelligence Service]], making her the first woman to lead the agency. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czxyx04dv1wo (BBC News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025 24 Hours of Le Mans]]
**In [[Endurance racing (motorsport)|endurance racing]], the [[AF Corse]] [[Ferrari]] team wins the [[24 Hours of Le Mans]] for the third consecutive year, with drivers [[Phil Hanson (racing driver)|Phil Hanson]], [[Robert Kubica]], and [[Yifei Ye]]. [https://apnews.com/article/le-mans-ferrari-24-hours-robert-kubica-affc5f1389e85c7bcf4d0d8a794caffb (AP)]
*[[2025 Queen's Club Championships]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Tennis in Germany|German]] player [[Tatjana Maria]] defeats [[Tennis in the United States|American]] player [[Amanda Anisimova]] 6–3, 6–4, in the [[Queen's Club Championships]] [[2025 Queen's Club Championships – Women's singles|women's singles final]] to become the event's first female winner since [[Tennis in Russia|Russia]]'s [[Olga Morozova]] in [[1973 Queen's Club Championships|1973]]. At 37 years old, Maria also becomes the oldest winner of a [[WTA 500 tournaments|WTA 500]] event. [https://sports.ndtv.com/tennis/qualifier-tatjana-maria-completes-fairytale-run-to-queens-title-8675525 (NDTV)]
*[[2025 U.S. Open (golf)|2025 U.S. Open]]
**In [[golf]], [[JJ Spaun]] wins the 2025 [[U.S. Open (golf)|U.S. Open]] with a score of [[par (score)|one-under-par]] to win his first [[Men's major golf championships|major title]]. [https://www.espn.com/golf/story/_/id/45520741/jj-spaun-captures-first-major-title-wins-125th-us-open (ESPN)] [https://www.pgatour.com/tournaments/2025/u.s-open/R2025026/leaderboard/player/52215 (PGA)]
